//: Copy this file to config.json and adjust. Every key is optional — omit a key to use its default.
//enabled: Master switch. Set false to idle the watcher (it keeps polling CDP but clicks nothing).
//dryRun: true = log what would be clicked without clicking. Strongly recommended for the first run.
//policy: commands-only | commands-and-edits | everything — see README. CLI --policy overrides this.
//cdp: DevTools endpoint settings. Antigravity must be started with --remote-debugging-port=<port>.
//scan: Scanner timing. pollIntervalMs: idle DOM scan cadence (event-driven in between).
//dedupe: Anti-duplicate clicks. perButtonCooldownMs: same element can't be clicked twice within window.
//commands: Command filtering for terminal 'Run' prompts (word-boundary match, substring-ish).
//limits: Rate limiting. maxActionsPerMinute: 0 = unlimited. maxConsecutiveFailures: watcher exits after this many failed clicks in a row.
//logging: logLevel: debug | info | warn | error. logFile: null = stderr only.
